sections.appearance: Koharu has pink eyes and pink hair with bangs that cover her forehead. Her hair is styled into two chest-length twintails by red ribbons, which also frames her face. She has crow-like wings on her head and lower back. Halo ==== Koharu's halo consists of two pink rings that fade into a lighter tone downwards, with a pair of wings on top and a pair of bean-like shapes below. Uniform ==== Koharu wears a black Trinity school uniform consisting of a black sailor-like sweater, a white and pink sailor collar, a pink sailor-like ribbon, a dark pink pleated skirt and white leg warmer socks. The sailor-like sweater is a bit loose on her left shoulder, revealing a white bra strap. Gym: She was wearing a black athletic jacket with the trinity logo on the left, with white sleeves and black stripes. She was also wearing black athletic shorts with white stripes on the sides. She was wearing a pair of black and white sneakers with white laces. Firearm ==== thumb|Justice Black|150px She uses a black Pattern 1914 Enfield bolt action battle rifle with pink retaining bands. A snail charm hangs on the forward rifle sling point. Her club's name is stamped on the receiver furniture. Her rifle is wrapped in a black shroud when not in use.

sections.personality: Koharu is a naive and delusional young girl with a good heart, while her skills allowed her to become a part of the Justice Realization Committee. However, because of her poor intellect and delusional behavior, she is often set back. Notably, she expresses a strong prudishness, calling out anything remotely suggestive and/or lewd. Despite this, she is often caught having doujins and other explicit material, a clearly hypocritical behavior. Because of her delusions, she also believes that Sensei has strong sexual fantasies towards her and fully expects to be ravaged by them, though she often denies this in turn. She is a girl struggling to reconcile her own personal standards with her burgeoning adolescence. However, beneath it all she is a dependable person who provides lighthearted banter and a trampoline to bounce off of for the Supplementary Lesson Department.
